extra.text: The seed vault's ward has dimmed. Bring three Source gems; they will be consumed to renew the seal against damp and vermin.
Your first verified completion counts as Lamplighters civic service. Joining the guild is optional.

accept.text: Three is enough for the ward. More would only turn prudence into hoarding.

decline.text: Then let the work wait. No living bargain is improved by reluctant hands.

in_progress.text: Return three Source gems to the steward of this vault.

ready.text: The gems are clear, matched, and ready for the warding frame.

extra.text: The seal will spend their Source slowly through the wet season. A generation of seed sleeps safer.
The Lamplighters will remember your service. Ask a guild contact about introductions and workshop commissions.
